page_title: ANG 0-2 MON | Angers v Monaco 15/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Willy Delajod has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Himad Abdelli (Angers) receives a pass on the edge of the box and attempts a lob as the keeper is off his line, but the effort crashes off the right post.
90+1' The substitution is prepared. Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mika Biereth.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' 0 - 2 Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) slides the penalty home!
88' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
87' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Marius Courcoul (Angers). A penalty is awarded to Monaco!
86' Substitution. Haris Belkebla walks off the pitch and Ibrahima Niane (Angers) comes on as a substitute.
84' Here is a change. Yassine Belkhdim is going off and Alexandre Dujeux gives the last tactical orders to Pierrick Capelle (Angers).
84' It is time for a substitution. Bamba Dieng (Angers) is on for Esteban Lepaul.
84' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to make a change. Marius Courcoul (Angers) replaces Carlens Arcus.
82' The substitution has been made. Christian Mawissa Elebi (Monaco) has replaced Caio Henrique.
82' Haris Belkebla (Angers) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul. Monaco have been awarded a free kick.

80' Farid El Melali (Angers) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Philipp Kohn tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.

77' 0 - 1 Mika Biereth (Monaco) meets a perfect cross from Caio Henrique deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:1.
72' Lamine Camara (Monaco) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
68' Adi Hutter prepares a substitution. Vanderson is replaced by Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
68' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Takumi Minamino (Monaco).
67' Today's match ends for Jim Allevinah who will be replaced by Farid El Melali (Angers).
65' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) serves up a nice cross, but Yahia Fofana punches the ball away.
61' A pass from Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) is intercepted by Philipp Kohn and the move breaks down.
60' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
60' The resulting set piece from Monaco is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
56' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
54' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) dribbles into the box, but Philipp Kohn is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
52' Himad Abdelli (Angers) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
49' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) commits a rough foul. Willy Delajod stops the game and makes a call.
46' Half-time substitution. Al Musrati (Monaco) will not participate anymore and Lamine Camara is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) is replaced by Breel Embolo.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. Corner kick. Monaco will have an opportunity.
45+1' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Monaco.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Caio Henrique (Monaco) was quite harsh and Willy Delajod didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Caio Henrique (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
40' Caio Henrique (Monaco) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
38' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
35' Willy Delajod interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jim Allevinah (Angers).
30' Yahia Fofana leaps to intercept the corner kick from Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).

30' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Monaco earn a corner.
28' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) takes the corner which is cleared.

28' Mika Biereth (Monaco) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Yahia Fofana has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
27' A lofted cross from Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
24' That's unlucky! Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
18' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
18' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt. Now Monaco have a corner.
16' Himad Abdelli (Angers) is able to continue to play.
16' The resulting corner, taken by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco), comes to nothing.

16' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
14' Looks like Himad Abdelli (Angers) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
9' Caio Henrique (Monaco) makes a strong challenge and Willy Delajod blows for a foul.
7' What a chance that is! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
6' The Monaco players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Vanderson (Monaco) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yahia Fofana, who smothers the ball.
2' Unlucky! Vanderson (Monaco) hits a thunderous volley on the edge of the box that just flies just wide of the left post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
There's an opportunity for Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
The players are on the pitch and Monaco will have the kick-off.
Willy Delajod was nominated as the referee for this game.
